title: Phase 2: durable hold table and tracker-mediated release for A11 (strike-out)
description: ma5 shipped A11 adapter-only: MayDispatch reads holds, but the hold table is written only by the lifecycle fixture's adapter and a person's release is 'ticfac settle' recorded as a decision. Making it real needs (a) a durable hold in the checkpoint: extend $defs.tick_state or add a holds field (checkpoint schema is additionalProperties:false) in the contract bundle; (b) release through the tracker via tk awaiting/approve, which must be added to the Tracker seam and the pinned tk-json manifest. See RESULT-ma5.md item 7 and the section note above A11 in internal/reconcile/guards.go.
